_note: Serine protease family definitions for fetch_serine_proteases.py. The family granularity is MEROPS (clan = superfamily, family = Sxx). Each MEROPS family maps ~1:1 to a Pfam/InterPro domain, which is the practical query handle in UniProt (xref:pfam-PFxxxxx). VERIFY each pfam<->MEROPS mapping on the MEROPS family page (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/merops/) before trusting counts. Entries with "verify": true have NO confirmed handle yet -- fill in pfam/interpro before running, or they are skipped. You can also override per family with a raw "query" string.
